cohort: Mothers and infants in Bangladesh from five Demographic and Health Surveys (2004, 2007, 2011, 2014, and 2017-2018).
finding: Both EIBF and EBF increased significantly in Bangladesh between 2004 and 2017-2018, while CBF decreased.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery was associated with lower EIBF practice compared with vaginal delivery.
